description: Eight-relay DIN-rail module (12 V) controlled over RS485 with Modbus RTU
source: LaskaKit, 8 channel Rail RS485 Relay command document (8ch_rele_rs485_protocols.pdf), linked from the product page LA143052

sources.title: 8 channel Rail RS485 Relay command
sources.note: MODBUS 06 control and 03 read status commands, with examples

notes: LaskaKit 8-channel 12 V DIN-rail RS485 relay module (LA143052).

Registers 1 to 8 are relays 1 to 8. A write puts the command in the high byte and a delay in the low byte: channel 1 open is 01 06 00 01 01 00, channel 1 delay 10 s is 01 06 00 01 06 0A. A read returns 0x0001 (open) or 0x0000 (closed). Several channels can be read in one request.

The slave address comes from DIP switches A0-A5. 9600 bit/s by default (2400, 4800 or 19200 with the M1/M2 pads), 8 data bits, no parity, 1 stop bit. With the M0 pad shorted the module uses AT commands instead of Modbus.
The module only answers valid commands.

registers.name: All channels
registers.description: Write 0x0700 to open all relays or 0x0800 to close all (function 06).

registers.name: Channel 1 relay
registers.description: Write with function 06: high byte = command, low byte = delay. 0x0100 open, 0x0200 close, 0x0300 toggle (self-locking), 0x0400 latch (inter-locking), 0x0500 momentary (1 s), 0x06nn delay of nn seconds (0 to 255). Read with function 03: 1 = open, 0 = closed.
